name: Sanguine Secrets

components.m: a drop of blood, which the spell consumes

summary: Learn a creature's species, creature type, current Hit Points, conditions, and its damage and condition Resistances, Vulnerabilities and Immunities; your next check or attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
text: You draw knowledge through the power of blood about a creature you can see within 30 feet; the drop of blood is consumed. You learn its species and creature type, its current Hit Points, and any conditions affecting it. You also learn whether it has Vulnerability, Resistance or Immunity to any damage types or conditions, and which. In addition, the next ability check or attack roll you make against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
